summary: (c) Hold and declare that the Petitioners are entitled to an extension of 12 months in the Project's commissioning date on account of force majeure events; (d) Hold and declare that the Petitioners shall be eligible for 100% waiver of inter-State transmission charges, subject to the Petitioner No.1’s Project being commissioned on or before the revised commissioning date of 30.06.2026 and/or; (e) Pass an interim order directing the Respondent No. 1 not to levy, raise, recover or enforce any ISTS transmission charges attributable to Petitioner No. 1/MRPL’s RE Generation Project, payable by the customers viz., WLL/Petitioner No. 2 and WCL/Petitioner No. 3 herein, who have also separately filed a petition bearing Petition No. 736/MP/2025 that is presently pending before this Hon'ble Commission; (f) Pass any such other of further order/s as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case. Submission by the Petitioner in Petition No. 779/MP/2025: 4. The Petitioners have mainly submitted as under: (a) MRPL is setting up а Wind-Solar Hybrid Power Project of 250 MW (AC) capacity at Jamnagar in the State of Gujarat, which is proposed to be evacuated at Jam Khambaliya PS at 220kV level through a single-circuit transmission line. (b) WLL and WCL are Bulk Consumers and tasked to construct 220 kV Bus Extension (AIS) of Bhachau 400/220 kV (PG) S/S along with 2 nos. AIS bays at Bhachau S/s on the extended Bus, as per the GNA grant dated 01.12.2023 (hereinafter referred to as “Bhachau Project”) so as to evacuate power from the MRPL’s RE Generation Project. (c) A Power Purchase Agreement (hereinafter referred to as “PPA”) dated 26.02.2024 was executed between MRPL and WCL for the supply of 42 MW of power. Additionally, a separate PPA dated 26.02.2024 was executed between MRPL and the WLL for the supply of 47 MW of power. The Project's commencement date was agreed to be 30.04.2025, the date on which MRPL would be ready to deliver electricity. (d) MRPL on 15.09.2023 submitted its application for grant of connectivity for 250 MW. CTUIL, vide intimation letter dated 17.11.2023, informed MRPL that in-principle connectivity had been granted for its wind-solar hybrid project at the Jam Khambhaliya PS (GIS). The start date of connectivity as mentioned in the said letter is 31.03.2026. (e) MRPL had, from the inception, undertaken structured planning of all activities pertaining to the 250 MW RE Generation Project, with the intention of commissioning the Project on or before the scheduled date for commencement of connectivity of WCL and WLL, i.e., 30.04.2025 at Bhachau substation for drawal. (f) Petitioner faced several events leading to delay of the project. Order in Petition No. 779/MP/2025 along with 103/IA/2025 & 108/IA/2026 Page 3 the DTL by State Government authorities), delay in allotment of Government land for the solar project, and delays caused by flood and cyclone events. The Petitioners also submitted additional information and clarifications vide submissions dated 21.05.2026, 23.05.2026 and 27.05.2026 addressing the queries and furnishing further details relating to project planning, connectivity arrangements, project progress and reasons for delay. (c) On 19.06.2026, the Committee issued its final report in respect of the Petitioners’ representation and recommended extension of the SCOD of MRPL’s hybrid Project up to 30.06.2026. (d) Petitioners seek adoption of the Committee’s recommendations by this Commission. Considering that part commissioning of the Project has already been achieved, and the balance capacity is likely to be commissioned by the end of June 2026, any further delay in issuance of the appropriate order would adversely impact the commercial viability of the Petitioners’ Project. (e) Pending adjudication of the present Petition and in view of the facts and circumstances of the case, it is imperative that this Commission, as an interim measure, until the final disposal of the present Petition, directs CTUIL not to levy or recover any ISTS transmission charges attributable to MRPL’s RE Generation Project, payable by the customers viz., WLL and WCL herein, who have also separately filed a petition bearing Petition No. 736/MP/2025 that is presently pending before the Commission. Hearing dated 7.7.2026 in 108/IA/2026: 9. During the course of hearing, the learned senior counsel for the Petitioners submitted that by way of the IA No. 108/IA/2026, the Petitioners have placed on record the Report of the Committee, constituted under Regulation 13(2)(h) of the 2020 Sharing Regulations, dated 19.6.2026, whereby the Committee has recommended the extension of the Scheduled Commercial Operation Date of the MRPL’s Project up to 30.6.2026. 10. In response, the representative of the Respondent/CTUIL submitted that the Report of the Committee has already been placed on record and CTUIL does not wish to file any further submissions in the matter. 11. Vide RoP dated 7.7.2026, the Petition was admitted along with the IA. The Respondents were directed to file their brief replies, if any.
